profile.positioning: I build web applications that pair solid engineering with thoughtful interface design — made not just to work, but to have a clear architecture, clean organization, and an experience people enjoy using.

body.intro: I work where backend engineering meets interface design — I like systems that have to hold up under real load, and interfaces that make those systems easy to understand.
body.study: I’m a Software Engineering student, and I use projects outside the classroom to put into practice ideas that university only covers in theory — architecture, data consistency, performance, accessibility.
body.approach: I prefer simple solutions that solve the right problem over abstractions built for problems that may never show up.
